## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile/tablet 3D Oregon police simulator with first-person driving and realistic traffic.
- Add fuel management requiring gas stops, detailed traffic-car interiors, and a CAD screen with randomly generated plates and identities.

## Requirements
- User requested: “make me a mobile police simulator thats realistic to the police in Oregon with first person view and realistic traffic (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)”
- User additionally requested a fuel system, detailed car interiors, and CAD with randomly generated plates and identities.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone browser game in `index.html`, using Three.js from jsDelivr.
- Chose fictional Cascade County / US-26 patrol setting; the intro explicitly labels the simulation and CAD data as fictional.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built a Three.js first-person patrol scene with road, roadside trees/signs, traffic, cruiser cabin/dashboard, responsive HUD, and touch/keyboard driving controls.
- Added mission/dispatch, radar interaction, traffic-stop flow, pause/end screens, and visual fuel gauge / CAD panel markup.
- Started a local HTTP server on port 3002 and opened the game in Playwright. Saved `screenshots/oregon-patrol.jpg`.

### Active
- Implement the requested fuel depletion, gas station stop/refueling gameplay.
- Add car interior models and random plate/identity profiles to traffic vehicles.
- Wire CAD UI interactions and populate CAD records from generated vehicle profiles.
- Verify gameplay and mobile layout in browser; prior screenshot showed the intro screen.

### Blocked
- A targeted edit to `index.html` failed because the exact source snippet did not match; the traffic profile/interior change was not applied.
- Fuel and CAD currently have only UI markup/styles; gameplay logic and event wiring are not implemented.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `index.html` around `makeCar`, `traffic` initialization, `makeStop`, and `update(dt)`; apply smaller targeted edits to avoid another exact-match failure.
2. Add random plate/driver/vehicle profiles to traffic cars and add visible cabin details inside those cars.
3. Add a gas station location, fuel consumption/depletion, stop/refuel behavior, and related HUD updates.
4. Wire CAD button/modal to display the selected nearby vehicle’s generated record; ensure controls and stop flow work.
5. Re-test on desktop and a mobile viewport and save/read the latest screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entire game implementation, HUD, Three.js world, driving and mission logic.
- `screenshots/oregon-patrol.jpg`: Most recent saved visual check.

## Important Context
- Browser check produced one console error for missing `/favicon.ico`; several SwiftShader GPU stall warnings. The page title was `Oregon State Patrol — Cascade County`.
- The last unsuccessful edit attempted to replace the `makeCar` implementation with random profiles, CAD data, and detailed interiors; none of that replacement was applied.
